Overlay now shows a Transcribing… pill (spinner + label, matching accent aesthetic) during the gap between a successful stop command and the transcription result. Key discovery: the sidecar transcribes synchronously in its recording thread and emits TranscriptionReady BEFORE RecordingStopped (RecordingStopped is the final event of every pipeline, incl. too-short/no-speech recordings), so the transcribing phase cannot be derived from sidecar events. Instead, a new onCommandResponse hook in sidecar.ts lets the main process detect successful stop_recording / toggle_recording(recording:false) responses — covering all stop paths (tray, global shortcut, UI button, Linux hotkey via HotkeyTriggered→toggle_recording) — and pushes 'overlay:status: transcribing' to the overlay window. OverlayPage hides on RecordingStopped/TranscriptionReady/Error; createCanario hides the overlay window on TranscriptionReady/RecordingStopped/Error (no longer on stop). Tray race fixed: the 2s transcribing→idle setTimeout is now a cancellable module-level timer superseded by any newer tray state. typecheck+build pass.

Overlay window is repositioned/resized onto the display containing the cursor every time it is shown: positionOverlayWindow() uses screen.getDisplayNearestPoint(screen.getCursorScreenPoint()) and setBounds(display.bounds), called from the overlay:show IPC handler; initial creation also uses the primary display's full bounds (x/y included) instead of workAreaSize at 0,0. typecheck+build pass.
